# SoSimTech

> SoSimTech (Sosimtech Solutions) is a custom software development company that helps startups and mid-size businesses build great websites and intuitive mobile apps. It offers full-cycle services — from design and development to testing and SEO — so clients can focus on their core business while SoSimTech handles the technology.

## Services

- Web Development: on-time delivery of highly scalable web solutions, covering all phases of development and design.
- Mobility (Mobile App Development): highly functional, great-looking apps for smartphones, tablets, automobiles and watches.
- Testing / QA: full-cycle testing and quality assurance for web, desktop and mobile applications.
- SEO / Digital Marketing: sustainable, low-cost managed SEO delivered by an in-house team of SEO experts.
- Chrome Extension Development: extensions for Google Chrome and other Chromium-based browsers.
- Internet of Things (IoT): solutions for the "Internet of Things" within an affordable budget.
- Payroll Management: simple systems to manage employee financial records — salaries, deductions, bonuses and pay-slips.
- Extended Team: dedicated, customized development teams for flexibility, increased ROI and faster time to market.
